subject: general
question: Who took oath as the 28th Chief Minister of Punjab in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bhagwant Mann__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In March 2022 Bhagwant Singh Mann became the Chief Minister of Punjab.
 
• He is the Punjab cabinet minister and a member of the Aam Aadmi Party.
 
• On 20 February 2022, elections for the 117 members of the 16th Assembly of the Punjab Legislative Assembly were conducted in Punjab through which he gained a majority,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• AAP Punjab convener and MP Bhagwant Mann were sworn in as Chief Minister on 16 March 2022.
 
• Mann's ministry was formed with 10 cabinet ministers on 19 March 2022.
